name: Fatso
description: A big fat duck that loves to eat and waddle around the pond, always looking for snacks and fun.

name: Orange Head
description: A tall duck with an orange on his head, known for his love of citrus fruits and his bright personality that lights up the pond.

name: Baby Duck
description: The youngest member of the duck family, always curious and playful, bringing joy and laughter to everyone around with its adorable antics.

name: Widey
description: A wide-bodied duck who loves to spread his wings and enjoy the sunshine, often found lounging by the water's edge and soaking up the rays.

name: Duckles
description: The charismatic leader of the duck squad, known for his wisdom and bravery, always guiding his flock through adventures and challenges with a quack of confidence.

name: Fake Duck
description: A mysterious duck that looks real but is actually a clever decoy, often used to trick predators and protect the real ducks in the pond.

name: Baby Fake Duck
description: A smaller version of the fake duck, designed to look like a baby duckling, used to lure predators away from the real ducklings and keep them safe.

name: Combination Duck
description: A rare and mysterious duck that is said to be a combination of all the different types of ducks in the pond, possessing unique traits and abilities that make it a legend among the duck community.

name: Toilet Duck
description: A quirky duck that lives in the bathroom, known for its bright blue color and its ability to clean toilets with a powerful quack, making it a favorite among homeowners who want to keep their bathrooms sparkling clean.

name: Basketball Duck
description: A sporty duck that loves to play basketball, often seen dribbling a small ball with its beak and shooting hoops with impressive accuracy, inspiring other ducks to get active and have fun on the court.

name: Burger Duck
description: A delicious duck that looks like a burger, complete with a bun, lettuce, and cheese, known for its mouthwatering appearance and its ability to satisfy hunger cravings with just one look.

name: Snowboard Duck
description: A sporty duck that loves to snowboard down snowy slopes, showing off impressive tricks and speed, inspiring other ducks to try winter sports.

name: Eclipse Duck
description: A mysterious duck that only appears during solar eclipses, known for its dark feathers and its ability to bring a sense of wonder and awe to those who witness its rare appearances.

name: Dizzy the Acrobat
description: Performs amazing aerial tricks and stunts that leave everyone amazed.

name: Patches the Builder
description: Expert nest builder who creates the most comfortable homes in the pond.

name: Sparkle the Glamorous
description: Always looks fabulous and helps other ducks with their appearance and style.

name: Storm the Adventurer
description: Loves flying through storms and discovering new territories beyond the pond.

name: Cookie the Baker
description: Creates delicious bread crumb recipes and hosts the best picnics by the water.

name: Zen the Peaceful
description: Meditates by the lily pads and teaches mindfulness to all who seek inner peace.

name: Captain Quack
description: Commands the duck squadron with wisdom and courage, leading migrations across continents.
